mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, producing positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth (t-2mo to t-1mo) > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%
failure_condition: In periods where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500,000, it signals a robust consumer demand environment that supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong economic supply capacity that supports corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO is above its historical average are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300, it signals an overheated housing market that may lead to economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods where HOUST > 1300 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (INDPRO) exceeds 0.5% and GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 18600, it signals a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth (t-2mo to t-1mo) > 0.5% and GDPC1 > 18600
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO growth > 0.5% and GDPC1 > 18600, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 250), a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS < 3.0, the 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
